title: Deliver Copper Ore to Honbourne Bridge Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Copper Ore** delivered to **Honbourne Bridge Factory** (industry id 65, near tile 9,173).

A likely supplier is **Honbourne Bridge Copper Ore Mine** (industry id 1, near tile 10,198); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.
